newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: ABB to sell refrigeration busines.
newsitem.headline: ABB to sell refrigeration busines.

text.p: Electrical engineering group ABB Asea Brown Boveri AG said it was selling its worldwide refrigeration business for about $93 million to Danish company Sabroe Refrigeration A/S.
ABB said its refrigeration business had global sales of about $230 million with a workforce around 1,350 people.
"This divestiture is in line with our strategy to focus on our core business," ABB chief executive Goran Lindahl said in a company statement.
Sabroe had about 3,000 employees with sales of about 2.6 billion Danish crowns, ABB said.
It said the sale was subject to approval by the respective regulatory agencies.
ABB said its refrigeration business, managed from Sweden, covered the design, manufacture, sales and service of products and systems for industrial, commercial and marine refrigeration.
